text:
Maria: Kicked off a 48h staging soak this morning to validate per-org and per-key rate-limits with our new synthetic multitenant generator (synthgen).
Aj: Nice — what traffic patterns are you driving?
Maria: Mix of steady + burst. 70% poisson baseline, 20% scheduled spikes (10s bursts), 10% long tails to exercise token-bucket exhaustion.
Chris: Are we simulating both per-org and per-key quotas simultaneously? previous runs only tested one dimension at a time.
Maria: Yup — synthgen spins up 300 virtual orgs, each with 5 keys. We vary burst allowance per-org to match real distribution.
Sam: Quick note: observed ~2% 429s at t+6h in the first run. Most 429s lacked tenant_id on traces (pre-routing).
Keiko: Missing tenant_id is concerning — that prevents us from mapping errors to org quotas in dashboards. Did synthgen include the x-tenant header?
Maria: It did, but the 429s without tenant_id seem to be blocked before header enrichment (at the edge RL).
Lina: That suggests RL enforcement happens at edge and enrichers run downstream. We should log the pre-routing enforcement reasons.
Priya: For Console UX, customers expect to see "burst credits remaining" per-key in the quota panel. We should validate that the metric we expose aligns with enforcement behavior.
Chris: Also saw larger p99 latency spikes during bursts — maybe queueing in the request router when many keys hit bursting tokens.
Aj: Can we get a sample of the synthgen config? want to reproduce locally.
Maria: Paste of the relevant synthgen snippet:
```
clients: 300
keys_per_org: 5
baseline: poisson(rate=4rps)
burst: schedule(window=10s, rps=200, prob=0.2)
headers: {"x-tenant": org_id, "x-api-key": key_id}
duration: 48h
metrics: emit([429, lat_p95, lat_p99, token_bucket_level])
```
Sam: Thanks. When you ran it did you set RL to per-key first then per-org fallback, or per-org first? enforcement order matters.
Maria: Current staging policy is per-key -> per-org -> global. We wanted to test that fallback path.
Keiko: The logs show most 429s originated from per-key buckets exhausting, but a subset were per-org rejecting when one noisy key used all shared burst.
Lina: For telemetry, we need a span attribute `rl.enforced_by` with values like `per-key`, `per-org`, `global`. That will make dashboards much clearer.
Priya: I'll add a Console ticket to show that attribute in the per-route quota breakdown. UX should show which policy rejected requests and remaining burst credits.
Chris: From the soak: 429 distribution across orgs is heavy-tailed. Top 10 orgs produced ~45% of 429s. We should add an automatic heatmap panel to detect noisy tenants.
Aj: Suggestion: introduce jittered backoff in synthgen clients to avoid synchronized retransmits — realistic apps won't retry instantly.
Maria: Good call — updated next run with exponential jitter and capped retries (max 3) to mirror production.
Sam: Also noticed our RL metrics don't tag whether caching prevented enforcement (i.e., cache hit bypassed token consumption). We need to track `cache_hit=true/false` on RL metrics.
Keiko: If cache hits bypass token buckets, it skews RL economics. Important to measure actual billing tokens consumed vs allowed.
Lina: Ops request: add a per-org 429-rate alert in staging so we catch runaway tenants early in soak. Threshold: >1% 429s sustained for 15m for any org.
Maria: Plan for next steps: 1) enable pre-routing trace tags for enforcement reason, 2) add cache_hit tag on RL metrics, 3) update synthgen to jittered retries and run 48h again, 4) add heatmap and per-org 429 alert to staging dashboards.
Priya: Can Product owners review the Console mock showing per-key burst remaining + enforcement reason? I'll share a link after this thread.
Chris: One more: test interplay with model-routing fallback. When a model variant is unavailable and requests are routed to a lower-cost model, does RL still count against original key quota or the fallback model's quota? That was ambiguous.
Maria: We observed counts against original key. Might be fine, but we should document for customers.
Aj: I'll create a small smoke test for model-fallback + RL to verify counting semantics.
DevBot: deploy-bot posted: deploy staging/rl-config v2 -> successful.
Lina: Who's owning the instrumentation PR to add `rl.enforced_by` and `cache_hit` tags?
Keiko: I'll own the instrumentation. Will open PR by EOD.
Maria: Thanks team. If we can get the telemetry in before next run (tomorrow morning) we can capture cleaner traces for debugging.
Priya: Added Console ticket #PROD-872 to track UX changes.
Chris: Leave a note in the run summary with top noisy tenants + suggested quota tuning per-tenant — will be helpful for sales/CS.
Maria: Will post the full soak report once run finishes (including CSV of per-org 429s and p99 latencies).
Aj: 👍 thanks, team.
DevBot: alert: staging 429-rate heatmap panel created at 2026-03-18T09:20:00Z
Keiko: PR #432 opened: add rl.enforced_by & cache_hit tags, tests included.
Maria: Great — closing this coordination thread, moving detailed debug to the soak report thread when ready.
